story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. In plain words: An alignment paradigm that trains models to critique and refine responses using a specified set of behavioral principles rather than direct human annotation. Here is how it actually plays out: Constitutional AI operationalizes harmlessness and helpfulness training by employing automated model supervision, removing human annotators from exposure to toxic red-teaming vectors while producing scalable supervision signals. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is Constitutional AI.
